title: Islands library size, gzipped
description: Bundle sizes (KB, gzip -9, full library imported) measured for DESIGN-0001 §2 on 2026-09-29. Solid wins on E1 at 4 KB gz; uPlot is reserved for large time series; Observable Plot ships more than 20x Solid; vega-embed is the interactive-mode escape hatch (lazy island only). Sizes are the source cited in DESIGN-0001 §2 'lean enough'.
